headline: Bosch Sensortec presents SystemC-AMS solver evaluation with MEMS and C2V models
fact: At SystemC Evolution Fika, Alexandra Küster of Bosch Sensortec presented an evaluation of solver efficiency in heterogeneous SystemC-AMS virtual prototypes. The slides compare PRECALC and SEGMENT approaches, adaptive time steps, feedback and discrete-event handling using MEMS and capacitance-to-voltage (C2V) models under repeated-shock conditions. This Event records the 2026 presentation, rather than the first publication of the underlying solver research.

sources.title: SystemC Evolution Fika: April 23, 2026
sources.summary: The official program identifies the April 23 presentation, Alexandra Küster and Bosch Sensortec.

sources.title: Toward Fast Heterogeneous Virtual Prototypes: Increasing the Solver Efficiency in SystemC AMS
sources.summary: Presentation slides describe PRECALC/SEGMENT, adaptive time steps, feedback/discrete events and MEMS/C2V evaluation scenarios. The underlying cited paper is from 2025.
